description: An informative lesson diagram has no text alternative.
whereInPage: The water-cycle diagram below the introductory paragraph.
exemptionsChecked: The diagram conveys the order and names of four stages; it is not decorative, a CAPTCHA, a control, or time-based media.

description: A content-bearing microscopy image uses a filename instead of an equivalent text alternative.
whereInPage: The plant-cell figure in the observation section.
exemptionsChecked: The image is instructional and its cell structures are discussed; it is not decorative or fully duplicated by adjacent text.

description: A section heading is conveyed only through bold, enlarged styling.
whereInPage: The 'Worked example' heading above the calculation.
exemptionsChecked: The text introduces and labels a distinct section; it is not merely emphasized prose.

description: Column headings in a data table are marked as ordinary data cells.
whereInPage: The header row of the planet comparison table.
exemptionsChecked: The grid compares planets across named measures and is a data table, not a layout table.

description: A related set of radio buttons has no programmatically determined group label.
whereInPage: The single-answer question in the quiz form.
exemptionsChecked: The same answer labels recur in other course quizzes, so the visible question is necessary group context; every individual option remains labelled.

description: CSS presents experiment steps in the correct order while the programmatic reading order is wrong.
whereInPage: The three-card procedure for testing soil acidity.
exemptionsChecked: The numbered sequence changes the procedure's outcome; multiple sequences are not valid.

description: An instruction identifies required content only by its visual position.
whereInPage: The instruction above two concept cards.
exemptionsChecked: Position is the only identifier used in the instruction; no shape, name, or programmatic relationship supplies the same cue.

description: A field collecting the learner's own email address does not expose its input purpose.
whereInPage: The progress-report subscription form.
exemptionsChecked: The field collects information about the user, maps directly to the WCAG email input-purpose token, and is implemented in HTML.

description: The correct quiz answer is identified by green colour alone.
whereInPage: The reviewed answer list under question one.
exemptionsChecked: No text, icon, pattern, or programmatic state duplicates the green cue; the colour difference conveys correctness, not decoration.

description: Links embedded in lesson prose are distinguished from surrounding text only by a small colour difference.
whereInPage: The two resource links in the reading paragraph.
exemptionsChecked: Link and surrounding-text colours are below 3:1 against each other, and there is no underline, weight, icon, border, or other persistent cue.

description: Normal-size instructional text has less than 4.5:1 contrast against its background.
whereInPage: The study tip beneath the memory lesson.
exemptionsChecked: The text is 16px regular-weight, is not incidental, disabled, a logo, or part of an image, and both foreground and background are specified.

description: A link's text contrast passes at rest but falls below 4.5:1 when the link receives focus.
whereInPage: The 'Open practice set' link below the algebra example.
exemptionsChecked: The focused text remains normal-size, is not disabled or incidental, and the visible focus outline independently continues to satisfy focus visibility.

description: A fixed-height study note clips when text alone is resized to 200 percent.
whereInPage: The blue vocabulary note in the lesson body.
exemptionsChecked: The note is ordinary HTML text, not captions or an image of text; the layout does not require a fixed presentation.

description: A prose lesson is fixed at 42rem and requires horizontal scrolling at a 320 CSS-pixel viewport.
whereInPage: The entire reading panel inside the main lesson.
exemptionsChecked: The content is linear prose, not a data table, map, diagram, game, presentation, or other layout requiring two-dimensional presentation; nothing is clipped with overflow.

description: The visual boundary needed to identify a text field has less than 3:1 contrast.
whereInPage: The answer field in the short-response form.
exemptionsChecked: The white field and white page share a background, so the author-styled border is required to identify the control; it is not inactive or user-agent-only styling.

description: A checked state is shown with a fill that has less than 3:1 contrast against the adjacent colour.
whereInPage: The selected topic checkbox in the lesson filter.
exemptionsChecked: The checked state is required to identify the current selection, is author-styled, active, and not conveyed by another visible non-text cue.

description: A fixed-height definition clips when WCAG text-spacing overrides are applied.
whereInPage: The definition card for plate tectonics.
exemptionsChecked: The content is authored HTML text, no language or script requires different spacing, and clipping—not ordinary reflow—is the failure mechanism.

description: A custom answer-reveal control responds to click but has no keyboard activation handler.
whereInPage: The 'Reveal explanation' control beneath the quiz option.
exemptionsChecked: The function is neither freehand drawing nor dependent on the path of pointer movement; the same focusable control has no keyboard equivalent.

description: A focusable code exercise captures both Tab and Shift+Tab with no documented keyboard exit.
whereInPage: The editable code area between the instructions and submit button.
exemptionsChecked: No standard key, Escape command, or advised alternate key sequence moves focus away; trapping is not required by the activity.

description: The single character R resets the quiz everywhere on the page and cannot be disabled, remapped, or limited to a focused control.
whereInPage: The global keyboard shortcut described above the quiz form.
exemptionsChecked: The shortcut uses an unmodified printable character, remains active outside a focused component, and no settings or remapping mechanism exists.

description: A practice page redirects after 10 seconds with no way to turn off, adjust, or extend the time limit.
whereInPage: The document-level meta refresh and visible timing notice.
exemptionsChecked: The exercise is not real-time or essential, the limit is author-controlled and shorter than 20 hours, and no extension mechanism is offered.

description: An automatically moving announcement continues for more than five seconds without pause, stop, or hide controls.
whereInPage: The course announcement ticker above the lesson summary.
exemptionsChecked: Movement starts automatically, lasts beyond five seconds, appears alongside other content, is not essential, and no pause mechanism exists.

description: The HTML document title is empty and does not identify its topic or purpose.
whereInPage: The title element in the document head.
exemptionsChecked: The resource is a standalone web page, not an embedded document or a step whose title is supplied by a containing application.

description: Positive tabindex values move focus to Submit before the two required quiz answers.
whereInPage: The two answer fields and submit button in the checkpoint form.
exemptionsChecked: Sequential navigation affects operability because both answers are required before submission; the visual and DOM order is question one, question two, then submit.

description: Two identical 'Open lesson' links lead to different topics and have no programmatically associated topic context.
whereInPage: The action at the bottom of each recommended lesson card.
exemptionsChecked: The destinations differ; the visible topic text is in separate sibling paragraphs, not part of the link text, same sentence, paragraph, list item, table cell, preceding heading, or an associated label.

description: A section heading does not describe the glossary content that follows it.
whereInPage: The second-level heading above three photosynthesis definitions.
exemptionsChecked: The text is a real section heading, and the following content has one clear topic rather than intentionally mixed material.

description: Author CSS removes the only visible focus indicator from quiz buttons.
whereInPage: All three answer buttons in the multiple-choice question.
exemptionsChecked: The controls are keyboard operable, no alternate mode or persistent indicator shows focus, and the author overrides the user-agent outline.

description: A fixed course notice entirely covers a focused navigation control at the bottom of the page.
whereInPage: The 'Next lesson' link underneath the fixed bottom notice.
exemptionsChecked: The notice is author-created and present initially, is not user-opened or movable, and the focused control cannot be revealed without moving focus or scrolling it away from its intended position.

description: A destructive reset action completes on pointer-down, before the user can cancel by moving away.
whereInPage: The 'Reset response' button below the essay field.
exemptionsChecked: Completing on down-event is not essential; the action is not a keyboard emulation and can be completed on click/up instead.

description: A button's accessible name does not contain its visible label.
whereInPage: The worksheet download button in the resources section.
exemptionsChecked: The visible text is part of the control's label, the control is not symbol-only, and no punctuation or capitalization-only variation explains the mismatch.

description: Adjacent pagination targets are 20 by 20 CSS pixels with no spacing, so their 24-pixel spacing circles overlap.
whereInPage: The numbered question navigation below the quiz progress label.
exemptionsChecked: Targets are author-sized, adjacent, non-inline, non-essential, have no conforming equivalent, and their centers are only 20px apart; all five WCAG exceptions were ruled out.

description: The page's default human language is not programmatically determined.
whereInPage: The html root element.
exemptionsChecked: The page is natural-language English content, not language-neutral names, code, or an empty shell.

description: A full Spanish sentence inside an English lesson has no programmatically determined language change.
whereInPage: The example sentence in the bilingual ecology note.
exemptionsChecked: The passage is an ordinary Spanish sentence, not a proper name, technical term, indeterminate word, or vernacular adopted into English.

description: An automatically detected answer error is identified only as 'Error' without describing what is wrong.
whereInPage: The prevalidated number-answer field and adjacent error text.
exemptionsChecked: The error is already detected and marked with aria-invalid; the item is identified, but the allowed numeric range is known and the nature of the error is not described.

description: A constrained study-time field gives no visible instruction for its required 24-hour format.
whereInPage: The study-time input in the schedule form.
exemptionsChecked: The accepted format is author-constrained and not customary for every user; the field has an accessible visible label, so missing-name failures are excluded.

description: A known-format input error is described but no correction suggestion is provided.
whereInPage: The enrollment-code error shown above the resubmission button.
exemptionsChecked: The required correction is known, specific, safe to disclose, and would not jeopardize content security or purpose; the error itself is already identified in text.

description: Repeated print controls use unrelated visible labels across a defined set of lesson pages.
whereInPage: The print controls in the two lesson toolbars; reference.html supplies the matching control on the second page in the set.
exemptionsChecked: All controls invoke the identical print function. The current page and reference.html are authored as two pages in one course set, and their contexts do not require different identification; reference.html is support evidence and is not a scored target.

description: A keyboard-operable custom completion control has no programmatically determined role.
whereInPage: The 'Mark lesson complete' control below the lesson summary.
exemptionsChecked: The span is scripted as a user interface control and focusable; its text supplies a name and its keyboard handler works, isolating the missing role.

description: An expanded custom disclosure does not expose its expanded state to accessibility APIs.
whereInPage: The 'Hide worked example' disclosure button above the visible panel.
exemptionsChecked: The control has a native button role and an accessible name; the visible panel establishes a current expanded state, but no state property communicates it.

description: A scripted results count appears without a role or property that lets assistive technology determine it as a status message.
whereInPage: The lesson-search results message populated during initial rendering.
exemptionsChecked: The update reports search results without taking focus or changing context; it is not an alert dialog, direct control label, or ordinary static prose.
